column1: # Published refusals that no capture has ever shown, taken from
# `qa/coverage/unreached-lines.md`. Each is one keypress from a fresh
# start, which makes them the cheapest coverage in the backlog:
#   - `No lock!`          - J-Jimmy with nothing lockable in front
#   - `No reagents owned!` / `Nothing to mix!` - M-Mix with an empty pouch
#   - `Not in doorway!`   - the door-close refusal off a doorway
# Seedless on purpose. `hut-ready-refusals` shows the pattern: `c`, a typed
# name and Return puts both sides in Iolo's hut with the shipped starting
# party, which carries no reagents and stands on no ladder, so every refusal
# above is reachable without a profile to keep in step.
# This asserts nothing about which line each key produces - that is what the
# comparison is for. It puts both sides through the same keys and lets the
# comparator say whether they agree, which is the only way an unreached line
# The direction answers are a first pass: `commands.md` Section 5.3 makes
# Jimmy and Klimb operand-follows echoes, and whether the hut's geometry
# refuses before or after the direction is what the capture will show. Expect
# to trim once it has run.
